cutover.verdict: PARTIAL (the cut is right in intent, under-specified in time zone)
cutover.what_selects: STEP 0 class 2: msgid: Email rows 'Captured before 2026-11-02' and (unlinked since 29 Oct, or created since 1 Nov 12:00 JST). A touched row leaves the class only because 'Captured today' >= 2026-11-02.
cutover.own_rows: From 2 Nov, capture's new STEP 1 rows ('Captured: today') and its re-stamps are >= 2 Nov, so they are excluded. Correct.
cutover.timezone_gap: 'today' is never defined as a JST date, and the only clock the prompts name is 'Bash `date -u`'. JST 00:00-08:59 on 2 Nov is still 1 Nov UTC, so a literal model stamps Captured 2026-11-01. Then (a) stamped rows created since 1 Nov 12:00 JST stay in the queue and are re-taken hourly; (b) rows capture itself creates in those hours (Captured 1 Nov, created after 1 Nov 12:00 JST) fall into STEP 0 class 2 and get a second 'capture:' line. Safe deploy is on or after 2 Nov 09:00 JST, or put 'today = TZ=Asia/Tokyo date +%F' in both prompts.
cutover.if_deployed_1_Nov: Every stamp is 2026-11-01, still before the cut: STEP 0 never drops a row that day; ordering 'oldest Captured first, then oldest Date' re-takes the same oldest rows each run and starves the rest; all of capture's own new rows (created after 12:00 JST) join STEP 0 class 2. Self-heals on 2 Nov (UTC) but wastes the 15-row budget all day.
cutover.other_dependents: Actions selects 'rows Captured on or after the day before W's date' (initial W 1 Nov 12:00 JST, so Captured >= 31 Oct). Old linked rows from 31 Oct/1 Nov lack 'capture:' and are skipped, which is correct. But re-keyed allmail: rows of any age are stamped and replayed (B2 residual). No other routine selects Activities by Captured (checked routines/*.md: the Captured filters in cowork-evals and whatsapp are on Engagements and FT Network). Re-stamping Captured does overwrite the original capture date on old Activities, which runs against the CLAUDE.md provenance rule.
